backupRequirements: Before separately authorized rollout: save complete Deployment to operator-owned 0700 directory/0600 file; never Git. Record resourceVersion and replica count.
Confirm old image remains in the management node image store and export a protected rollback archive; do not prune the local import.
Capture existing CAPC conditions/webhooks/CRDs and logs before changing the image.
plannedCommands: kubectl -n capc-system get deployment capc-controller-manager -o yaml > "$PROTECTED_BACKUP/capc-deployment.yaml"
kubectl -n capc-system patch deployment capc-controller-manager --type=json --patch-file capc-candidate-image-patch.json
readiness: Deployment observedGeneration current, desired/updated/available replicas equal; manager Ready; imageID resolves to candidate.
No CrashLoopBackOff, leader-election/RBAC errors, reconciliation panic, webhook TLS/admission errors or provider version mismatch.
CAPC CRDs Established; provider inventory, webhook service endpoints and TLS remain healthy.
rollbackTrigger: Any failed readiness/admission/provider check or new controller error; do not create workload objects to diagnose rollout.
rollbackSource: Existing locally imported image; not registry-backed. Source checkout /home/opc/.local/share/layersentry/rke2-poc/capc-source is supplementary, not a substitute for retaining/exporting the exact old image.
